# wiki/vendors

Vendor, framework, tool, and cloud evaluations live here.

Use this folder when a choice may affect:

- cost;
- lock-in;
- security;
- maintenance;
- developer experience;
- deployment complexity;
- ai-agent friendliness.

## rules

- Compare options against explicit criteria.
- Link the decision that accepted or rejected a vendor.
- Add review conditions and review date.
- Mark outdated comparisons `stale`.
